high_level_description: This image captures a serene scene at what appears to be a park or open area during sunset. The focal point of the image is a large statue of a person riding a horse, mounted on a pedestal. The statue is positioned centrally in the frame, with the sun setting behind it, casting a warm golden glow across the landscape. The setting includes a mix of natural and urban elements. In the foreground, there is a patch of grass and some low-lying vegetation, which seems to be overgrown. Behind the statue, there is a paved path where a few individuals can be seen walking or cycling.
